heading: Time limits for filing a charge-sheet
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A proceeding for a summary offence must be commenced within 12 months after the date on which the offence is alleged to have been committed except where—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: otherwise provided by or under any other Act; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused gives written consent, and the DPP or a Crown Prosecutor consent, to the proceeding being commenced after the expiry of that period.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See Part 5.1A of Chapter 5 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005 for a shorter time limit in relation to children.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 7(1) amended by No. 32/2024 s. 1039.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "7", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 46, "rect": {"page": 46, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 395.9, "x1": 127.1, "y1": 432.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See Part 5.1 of Chapter 5 of the Youth Justice Act 2024 for a shorter time limit in relation to children.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A proceeding for an indictable offence—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "7", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: may be commenced at any time, except where otherwise provided by or under this or any other Act; and

text: may be heard and determined summarily even though the proceeding may have been commenced more than 12 months after the date on which the offence is alleged to have been committed.

heading: Court may issue summons or warrant to arrest
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the filing of a charge-sheet under section 6, an application may be made to a registrar of the Magistrates' Court for the issue of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summons to answer to the charge directed to the accused; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a warrant to arrest in order to compel the attendance of the accused—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: unless a notice to appear has been served on the accused under Division 2.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: There is a presumption in favour of proceeding by summons if an accused is a child—see section 345 of the Children, Youth and Families Act 2005.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 12(1) inserted by No. 1/2016 s. 22(2), amended by No. 32/2024 s. 1040.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 53, "rect": {"page": 53, "x0": 467.9, "y0": 397.8, "x1": 511.9, "y1": 471.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: There is a presumption in favour of proceeding by summons if an accused is a child—see section 147 of the Youth Justice Act 2024.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1)(b) must be made by the informant personally but an application under subsection (1)(a) may be made by the informant or a person on behalf of the informant.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 12(3) amended by No. 20/2025 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 53, "rect": {"page": 53, "x0": 467.9, "y0": 570.4, "x1": 511.9, "y1": 606.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An application under subsection (1) may be made by the applicant in person, by post, by electronic communication or otherwise in accordance with the manner prescribed by the rules of court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application under subsection (1), the registrar must, if satisfied that the charge discloses an offence known to law, issue—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a summons to answer to the charge; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: subject to subsection (5), a warrant to arrest.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 12(5) amended by No. 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 38.1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "12", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 54, "rect": {"page": 54, "x0": 79.3, "y0": 178.6, "x1": 123.3, "y1": 224.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A registrar of the Magistrates' Court must not issue in the first instance a warrant to arrest unless satisfied by sworn or affirmed evidence, whether oral or by affidavit, that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: it is probable that the accused will not answer a summons; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused has absconded, is likely to abscond or is avoiding service of a summons that has been issued; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a warrant is required or authorised by any other Act or for other good cause.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused fails to appear in answer to a summons, sections 80 and 81 provide for the issue of a warrant to arrest the accused.  Section 330 provides for the issue of a warrant to arrest a person who has been remanded in custody or granted bail to attend a hearing but fails to attend.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "12", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 29 of the Magistrates' Court Act 1989 enables a magistrate to exercise the powers of a registrar to issue a summons or warrant.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "14", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": "2", "part": "2.3", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "14", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
